name: Sabah Half Marathon Powered by JomRun®
short_description: The Sabah Half Marathon Powered by JomRun® takes place on December 13, 2026, at Likas Stadium, Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia.

faqs.question: Where is the Sabah Half Marathon held?
faqs.answer: The Sabah Half Marathon Powered by JomRun® is held at Likas Stadium in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia. This venue serves as the starting point for the event, which takes place in the city of Kota Kinabalu within the Malaysian state of Sabah.

faqs.question: What distances can I run?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from three distance options at this event: 5km, 10km, or the primary distance of 21.1km, which is the half marathon distance. This range allows runners of different experience levels and fitness goals to select a suitable race option.

faqs.question: When does the race take place?
faqs.answer: The Sabah Half Marathon Powered by JomRun® is scheduled to take place on December 13, 2026. The event will be held at Likas Stadium in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia, offering runners multiple distance choices on that date.

faqs.question: Is registration currently open?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Sabah Half Marathon Powered by JomRun® is currently open. Interested runners can sign up now for one of the available distances -- 5km, 10km, or 21.1km -- ahead of the December 13, 2026 race date in Kota Kinabalu.
